title: A3IP Manifest
description: JSON Schema for A3IP manifest.yaml — AI Infrastructure Installation Package specification v1.10. Published at https://a3ip.dev/schema/v1.10/manifest.schema.json. Extends v1.5 with: dependencies.tools (Python / CLI / system-tool dependencies); auth_flows (multi-step OAuth/PAT/token flows); preserve_on_uninstall per configuration key (v1.10 uninstall lifecycle); platforms as a flat list (in addition to the v1.5 platforms.tested object shape).

$schema.description: URI of this schema. Add to every manifest for IDE validation.

a3ip.description: Spec version this manifest was authored against. Prefer min_a3ip_spec for compatibility declarations.

name.description: Unique package name. Must match the name in registry.yaml exactly. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

description.description: One-sentence description of what the package does. Used in registry listings.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or 'proprietary'. See https://spdx.org/licenses/

homepage.description: URL to the package documentation, repository, or landing page.

min_a3ip_spec.description: Minimum A3IP spec version required to install this package. Omit for v1.0-only packages.

latest_change.description: ISO 8601 date of the last change to this package. Updated by `a3ip new-version`.

trust_level.description: Highest trust level of any script in this package. Informational summary — individual script implementations also declare their own trust_level.

permissions.description: Pre-declaration of every external resource this package touches during install or operation. Shown to the user before any action is taken.

filesystem.description: Filesystem paths read or written by this package.

path.description: File or directory path. May use {{config.*}} substitutions.

access.description: Access level required. Omit only if access type is clear from context.

reason.description: Why the package needs this path. Shown verbatim in the install plan.

network.description: External domains contacted by this package.

domain.description: Hostname or domain. No wildcards — list each domain explicitly.

reason.description: Why the package contacts this domain. Shown verbatim in the install plan.

name.description: MCP server name as declared in the platform's MCP config.

reason.description: Why this MCP server is needed. Shown in the install plan.

shell.description: Shell commands or executables this package runs.

reason.description: Why this command is executed. Shown in the install plan.

components.description: Components bundled in this package. All paths are relative to the package root.

skills.description: SKILL.md-compatible skill folders. Each must contain a SKILL.md file.

artifacts.description: UI artifacts — persistent views the AI manages. Each must contain an artifact.md file.

scripts.description: Scripts executed during install or operation. Each script uses a primary-plus-adapters pattern.

key.description: Unique script key referenced in INSTALL.md.

parameters.description: Parameter names passed to this script.

implementations.description: One or more implementations of this script. Use platform 'any' for the cross-platform default.

file.description: Path to the script file relative to package root.

trust_level.description: Trust level for this implementation. If omitted, the AI must assume shell-exec (most conservative).

dependencies.description: External dependencies this package needs but does not bundle.

required.description: If false, the package degrades gracefully without this dependency.

purpose.description: What the package uses this MCP server for.

registry.description: Registry hint for auto-installation if supported.

fallback.description: Instructions for operating without this dependency. Required when required: false.

skills.description: Skill dependencies from other A3IP packages or external skill registries.

tools.description: Host-machine tool dependencies (Python, the a3ip CLI, git, etc.) that must be present at install time. Added in v1.10.

name.description: Tool name as invoked on the shell.

version.description: Version constraint expression (PEP 440-style or simple comparator). Use 'any' for no constraint.

required.description: If false, the package degrades gracefully without this tool.

install.description: Suggested install command for the user if the tool is missing.

fallback.description: Instructions for operating without this tool. Required when required: false.

configuration.description: Configuration schema for the CONFIGURE.md wizard. Values collected here are referenced as {{config.<key>}} throughout the package.

key.description: Config key. Referenced in package files as {{config.<key>}}.

label.description: Human-readable label shown to the user when asking for this value.

description.description: Explanation of what this value is used for.

type.description: Data type. Used for validation and collection.

required.description: Whether this value must be provided before installation proceeds.

sensitive.description: If true, the AI must never echo, log, or display this value. Confirm receipt only.

storage.description: Preferred storage target for sensitive values. Only relevant when sensitive: true.

placeholder.description: Example format to show the user (e.g. 'glpat-xxxx').

default.description: Default value applied if the user provides none.

example.description: Example value shown to the user for guidance.

when.description: When to collect this value: before all install steps, inline at the relevant step, or after install.

condition.description: Natural-language condition under which the AI should ask this question (e.g. 'only if Jira MCP is available').

options.description: Options for select and multi-select types.

refresh.description: When the AI should re-collect this value. Use 'on_expiry' for tokens with TTLs.

refresh_note.description: Human-readable note explaining when and why this value needs refreshing.

refresh_script.description: Key of the script that regenerates this value (must match a key in components.scripts).

preserve_on_uninstall.description: v1.10 uninstall policy for this key. true = silently preserve (credentials/tokens worth keeping). false = silently purge (meaningless after uninstall). 'ask' = prompt the user at uninstall time. Default behavior when omitted is 'ask' for safety. See A3IP spec v1.10 'Uninstalling a Package'.

auth_flows.description: Multi-step authentication flows (OAuth, PAT minting, token exchange) referenced by INSTALL.md. Each flow declares one or more steps the AI walks the user through to acquire a credential that then lands in a configuration key.

description.description: What this flow does and which config key receives the result.

script_key.description: Key of a script (in components.scripts) that automates part of the flow, if any.

stores_to.description: Configuration key the resulting credential is written to.

platforms.description: Platform compatibility information. Informational — not enforced at install time. Two accepted shapes: (a) flat list of tested platform IDs (the form `a3ip scaffold` emits in v1.10); (b) object with tested/untested arrays (v1.5 shape, still supported).

oneOf.description: Flat list of tested platform IDs.

tested.description: Platforms this package has been tested on and is known to work.

untested.description: Platforms that may work but have not been verified by the author.
